mostWorthwhile.text: Receiving the clinic shipment locally was the strongest payoff: the supplies reached the real door and Eli checked and recorded them without the company directory.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the pump and controller at the monitor felt like straightforward setup rather than meaningful decisions.

surprise.text: Asha's slow tap remained a separate job even though the repaired pump was reporting across both blocks; the link shared information rather than fixing everything.

arbitrary.text: The monitor placements felt procedural, although the subsequent key and controller checks gave them a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the neighbors handle the remaining work and maintain their shared services, though the procedural placements were less engaging.
